### Strong Workout Tracker {#review-app-1}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      8 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 28.03.2026 - 18.07.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _infrequent-yoyo_, 28.03.2026, 1/5: "I have used this app for years, although it is pretty good and collates all sorts of data into one place and is especially powerful for those interested in Powerlifting etc., the app has always been buggy, workouts not synchronising, workouts misalignment with iPhone and Apple Watch, workouts disappearing. These bugs have remained the same over more than 5 years of use and the developers haven’t bothered to fix them. It’s actually gotten worse where the app deletes workouts and won’t even synchronise between Watch and iPhone. I’ve had enough and won’t be renewing my subscription. Don’t waste your money if you hope to use an Apple Watch with this."
            2. _@fgrdt567_, 03.07.2026, 2/5: "Today is my first day working with this app. I’m entering custom exercises to build my first routine. The app has frozen several times and needed to be restarted."
            3. _PezzaP99_, 17.07.2026, 3/5: "Apple Watch app is very glitchy and isn’t very streamlined to use. I recommend Hevy for Apple Watch users, it works far better. If you’re just using a phone then this app will be fine."
<!--/ir-theme-->

### Google Health (Fitbit) {#review-app-6}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Gina Lisak_, 25.09.2026, 1/5: "Since the app changed to Google Health, I have syncing issues and lose data about once per month. I suspect it is because Google keeps trying to force 100% connection to my phone and notifications from several apps. They keep reverting my permissions during updates, without my consent. I had to lock it down at the device level to prevent it. I already have to sync daily, but it is still failing. If a company tries to change my behaviors, I will stop using their products and services."
            2. _Renee Carl_, 24.09.2026, 1/5: "The 9 Sept 2026 update still DOES NOT FIX the stats for swimming. I do not want my pace per mile! No one wants that. New update (June 2026) so many bugs. Absolutely no one tracks their swims in miles or kilometers. What happened to yards and meters? The update also took away average speed per 100. Fix the stupid AI agent providing useless responses to reviews providing specific bugs and problems with the app. Google, you broke fitbit, you need to fix it."
            3. _Jim Steenbergen_, 16.09.2026, 1/5: "Having the same issues as Kimberly on 6/15. Every time I have to update phone the sync gets messed up and I have to leave on charger and start using my "fitbit charge 2" watch, which is much more reliable. Plus it no longer reads my O2 or EKG. only one light on back lights up, where there use to be 3 lights!!!"

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Kathryn17*_, 10.10.2026, 1/5: "After four months of hoping the app redesign would be rectified, I am writing to discourage anyone who is about to pay for premium — as I did shortly before the redesign ruined what had been an outstanding app. Every update brings new features that are annoying, like the confetti with almost every entry that continues despite numerous complaints (mine included). This week’s update added a link to a “tip” where the swipe function had been, no way to bypass it. To make sure I hadn’t missed some miraculous design improvements, I scrolled through the recent reviews. For longtime members (like me, since 2014), the comments are overwhelmingly negative. I am writing again to say I cannot believe that this app could get worse, but the latest update is making it unusable. I’m getting constant “atta boys” when I log something. I am not five years old! And when I log from my list I have to scroll to return to where I selected an item to log. I just can’t believe that you care so little about all these customers, many of them for 10+ years like me, who are furious that you refuse to FIX THIS. If it were free I would simply walk away, but when I requested a refund I got a warning that all my data could be lost. I am furious but no one at MFP seems to care."

What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
